body:
### Description

Joining [#gnome-design:gnome.org](https://matrix.to/#/#gnome-design:gnome.org) results in

```
{"errcode":"M_UNKNOWN","error":"Internal server error"}
```

### Steps to reproduce

Not clear but maybe:

- Setup a synapse with workers (I got appservice, 1x fed reader, 3x fed senders, 1x frontent proxy, 1x generic worker, 1x pusher, 1x synchrotron, 1x user-dir)
- Try to join [#gnome-design:gnome.org](https://matrix.to/#/#gnome-design:gnome.org)  using the alias

### Homeserver

matrix.midnightthoughts.space

### Synapse Version

{"server_version":"1.72.0","python_version":"3.9.15"}

### Installation Method

Docker (matrixdotorg/synapse)

### Database

Using a single pg db from the start. PG version 13

### Workers

Multiple workers

### Platform

It's running within kubernetes using https://gitlab.com/ananace/charts/-/tree/master/charts/matrix-synapse

### Configuration

_No response_
